summary: Porsche Auto Funding LLC and Porsche Financial Auto Securitization Trust 2026-1 filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for a $911.0 million auto-loan ABS offering, upsized across five note classes. Class A-1 pays 4.345% due October 2027, A-2a 4.79% due June 2030, A-2b SOFR+0.31% due June 2030, A-3 5.19% due April 2032, and A-4 5.23% due July 2034. Notes price at 99.81%-100.00% with 0.170% underwriting discount; collateral is retail installment contracts on Porsche vehicles. Credit enhancement: 0.25% reserve, excess interest, overcollateralization and yield supplement. Monthly payments begin November 23, 2026.
